title: Men's Christmas – Mom's Favorite Crewneck Sweatshirt

seo.title: Sibling Gifts: Mom's Favorite Christmas Sweatshirt
seo.description: Sibling gifts that settle it: one stuffed stocking, one limp, under MOM'S FAVORITE. Check the stockings. Unisex crewneck, S–3XL.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

MOM'S FAVORITE. Check the stockings. A sibling gift for the brother who says it with a straight face at Christmas dinner, with the evidence hanging right there: one stocking stuffed with presents, candy canes and a toy truck, the other with a single candy cane.

The print is a 1960s storybook mantel in faded red, pine green, mustard and cream: a brick fireplace with a pine garland and two knit stockings, the left one overflowing with wrapped presents, candy canes, ornaments and a toy truck, the right one limp with one candy cane poking out. MOM'S FAVORITE. runs across the top in red slab capitals and CHECK THE STOCKINGS. runs across the bottom in heavy capitals, pine green on Sand and cream on Navy.

Wear it to Christmas dinner, the stocking-stuffing hour or any family gathering where the favorite-child bit is still running, or give it to the brother who always claims the title. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

How does the Mom's Favorite crewneck fit?
This classic unisex Gildan 18000 crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomy, cozy look over a long-sleeve tee. If the size is off, we offer one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

How warm is it and what is it made of?
The Mom's Favorite crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband and no hood. It is a mid-weight, cozy layer for Christmas morning and a long family dinner. Machine wash cold inside out and tumble dry low.

Is it a good gift for a brother?
Yes. A sister, a mom or a parent can order it for the brother who claims the favorite spot, and he can order it himself to annoy everyone. Each Graphic Tees Co. crewneck is $34.99 in sizes S through 3XL, and the free size exchange within 30 days makes it safe to give.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in Sand and Navy, both in sizes S through 3XL. On Sand the headline is red and CHECK THE STOCKINGS. pine green; on Navy the headline stays red and the bottom line turns cream so it stands out. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order, and a misprint is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.

When should I order for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the Mom's Favorite crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. Orders of $45 or more ship free, and a misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
